home.intro: I build data solutions that work — and keep them simple. With decades of experience in software engineering, Big Data and modern data platforms, I help companies turn complex data challenges into robust, maintainable systems and use AI where it creates real value.
home.principle: My guiding principle is kept simple: reduce unnecessary complexity, focus on what matters, and build solutions that last.
home.reputation: Clients and colleagues know me as someone who gets things done — a calm, pragmatic engineer and technical leader who brings clarity and stands like a rock when projects get chaotic.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy (English)
privacy.note: This English version is provided for convenience; the German version above is authoritative.

s1.heading: 1. Data Protection at a Glance
s1.p1: The protection of your personal data is important to me. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data is collected when you visit this website and how such data is processed.
s1.p2: Personal data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

s2.heading: 2. Controller
s2.p1: The controller responsible for data processing on this website within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:

s3.heading: 3. Hosting
s3.p2: When you visit this website, the hosting provider may process technical information necessary to deliver the website and ensure its secure and reliable operation. This may include, in particular:
items: IP address or anonymised IP address
technical information concerning the request and response
s3.p3: The processing of this information is necessary for the secure, reliable and efficient operation of the website.
s3.p4: The legal basis for this processing is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. My legitimate interest is the secure and technically reliable provision of this website.
s3.p5: STRATO acts as a service provider in connection with the hosting of this website.
s3.p6: Further information about STRATO's processing of personal data can be found in STRATO's privacy information.

s4.heading: 4. Contact Form
s4.p1: This website provides a contact form through which you can contact me.
s4.p2: When you use the contact form, the information you enter into the form is processed for the purpose of responding to your enquiry. Depending on the fields provided, this may include:
items: any other information you voluntarily provide in your message
s4.p3: The data is used solely to process and respond to your enquiry unless another use is permitted or required by law.
s4.p4: If your enquiry concerns the initiation or performance of a contractual relationship, the legal basis for processing is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR.
s4.p5: For other enquiries, the processing is based on my legitimate interest in responding to enquiries addressed to me pursuant to Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
s4.p6: Your data will be deleted when your enquiry has been conclusively dealt with and there is no legal obligation or other lawful reason to retain the data for a longer period.
s4.p7: Please do not submit sensitive personal information through the contact form unless this is necessary for your enquiry.

s5.heading: 5. LinkedIn
s5.p1: This website contains a link to my profile on LinkedIn.
s5.p2: The link is a standard external hyperlink. No LinkedIn plugin or embedded LinkedIn content is used on this website.
s5.p3: Data is therefore not transmitted to LinkedIn merely because a page containing the link is displayed. If you click the LinkedIn link, you will leave this website and be redirected to LinkedIn. LinkedIn may then process personal data in accordance with its own privacy policy.
s5.p4: LinkedIn is operated in Europe by:
s5.p5: For information about how LinkedIn processes personal data, please refer to LinkedIn's Privacy Policy.

s6.heading: 6. Cookies and Tracking
s6.p1: This website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking services.
s6.p2: If technically necessary cookies are used by the hosting platform or website software, they are used only to provide functions necessary for the operation of the website.
s6.p3: No personal data is used for advertising or cross-site tracking by me.

s7.heading: 7. SSL/TLS Encryption
s7.p1: This website uses SSL/TLS encryption to protect the transmission of confidential information, including information submitted through the contact form.
s7.p2: You can normally recognise an encrypted connection by the use of "https://" in your browser's address bar.

s8.heading: 8. Your Rights under the GDPR
s8.p1: Under the GDPR, you have various rights concerning your personal data. Subject to the applicable legal requirements, these include:

rights.term: the right to restriction of processing
the right to object to processing

s8.p2: Where processing is based on consent, you also have the right to withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future.
s8.p3: To exercise your rights, you may contact me using the contact details provided above.

s9.heading: 9. Right to Object to Processing
s9.p1: Where personal data is processed on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, you have the right under Art. 21 GDPR to object at any time, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to the processing of your personal data.
s9.p2: In the event of an objection, I will no longer process the personal data concerned unless there are compelling legitimate grounds for the processing which override your interests, rights and freedoms, or the processing serves to assert, exercise or defend legal claims.

s10.heading: 10. Right to Lodge a Complaint
s10.p1: You have the right under Art. 77 GDPR to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of your personal data infringes the GDPR.
s10.p2: You may in particular contact the supervisory authority responsible for your place of residence, place of work or the place of the alleged infringement.

s11.heading: 11. Changes to this Privacy Policy
s11.p1: I may update this Privacy Policy if the functionality of this website changes or if legal or technical developments make an amendment necessary.
